Ask on WhatsApp
What is Hustlr and how does it work?

Hustlr is an AI-powered WhatsApp marketplace in Zimbabwe that connects clients with vetted local skilled workers. You send a message describing the job in English, Shona, or Ndebele, and Hustlr matches you with available tradespeople near your location.

What types of skilled workers can I find on Hustlr?

Clients can hire verified technicians and artisans across major trades, including plumbers, electricians, solar system installers, tilers, painters, carpenters, mechanics, and appliance repair specialists.

Do I need to download an app to use Hustlr?

No. Hustlr operates entirely inside WhatsApp, allowing both clients and skilled workers to request quotes, compare matches, and coordinate jobs using minimal mobile data without installing a separate app.

Which cities and languages does Hustlr support?

Hustlr serves clients and workers across Zimbabwe—including Harare, Bulawayo, Gweru, Mutare, and Masvingo—and supports full conversational matching in English, ChiShona, and IsiNdebele.
